title: A great experience start to finish
quote:
I had a great experience with Good Doggos and the training provided for my dog, Tupac. The entire process was easy from start to finish. Coordinating dates was simple, and the pickup and drop-off process was very convenient.

Before training, Tupac struggled with walks and could be reactive around other dogs. Since completing the program, we've noticed a big improvement. He no longer pulls excessively on the leash, follows commands much better, and is much easier to walk. The trainer also worked on exposing him to other dogs and helping him become more comfortable in social situations.

Tupac still has some work to do, but this training gave him a strong foundation and set him on the right path. We're very happy with the progress he's made so far and appreciate the time, patience, and effort that went into helping him become a better-behaved and more confident dog.
